Method of Attack: Identifies user’s NetBeans directory, enumerates all projects, and embeds a malicious payload in project files and build JAR files
Ensures that every time a NetBeans project is built, the malicious payload gets executed, further ensuring propagation
Drops both payload and command and control software components into JAR files of other applications
Attack Vector: Cloning and building infected repositories from open-source platforms
Infecting the build process of other projects on the system during development
Package Manager: Maven (implied, as NetBeans is a Java IDE)
Indicators of Compromise: Infected open-source repositories serving backdoored projects
Malicious payload embedded in project files and build JAR files
